newsitem.headline: ESTONIA - NOON RADIO HEADLINES - JUNE 13.

text.p: These were the main headlines reported by Kuku Radio on Friday at noon. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Uhispank confirmed that they have no data about the non-existence of Paradiso SAL, which signed a $10 million agreement with the North-Estonian Bank and the central bank.
